script.title: REPORTING A BROKEN HEATER
script.scene_zh: 租屋房內 · 報修暖氣
script.story_hook: Reporting a broken heater on the coldest week of winter.
script.intro_zh: 在一年最冷的那週，回報暖氣故障。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, friends! Today: a heater that quit in the cold.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，朋友們！今天的主題：寒流中罷工的暖氣。
script.outro: That's all for this episode. Keep listening and stay warm!
script.outro_zh: 這一集就到這裡。持續練習聽力，記得保暖！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。
script.char_a_description: a lanky South Asian man in his mid twenties with messy dark wavy hair, wrapped in a gray hoodie and fluffy house slippers, shivering while holding a big mug
script.char_b_description: a sturdy Black woman in her forties with short copper dyed hair under a work cap, wearing a blue mechanic jumpsuit with a tool belt, jotting notes on her phone
script.youtube_title: 【🥶🔧暖氣報修英文】「隨時可以進來修」怎麼說？18句寒流緊急報修對話，聽完就會求助🏠｜Broken Heater English
script.youtube_title_en: “We'll Keep You Warm” — Reporting a Broken Heater
script.youtube_description:
寒流來襲，暖氣卻壞了？這段18句報修對話教你描述故障狀況、取得進門授權、確認修理時間，用語自然又有禮貌。整段美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口求援。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Cold snap, dead heater — now what? In this 18-line maintenance call you'll learn how to describe the problem, give permission to enter, and lock in a repair time, all in polite everyday American English with IPA and translation. Then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠暖氣報修英文｜描述故障・授權進門・約定時間｜聽完就會報修｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
天氣超冷，暖氣卻突然壞掉？
英文該怎麼打電話報修、說清楚狀況？

這一集帶大家走進寒流中的租屋套房，跟著房客從描述故障聲音、同意維修人員進門，到確認到場時間與事前準備，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🥶 描述故障：例如「it just blows cold air now」、「there's a clicking sound」。
🚪 授權進門：例如「Can we enter if you're out?」、「you can come in anytime」。
🕑 確認時間：例如「I'll send Marco this afternoon」、「usually under an hour」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次家裡東西壞了，先聽這一集再打電話！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a wall heater with a thumbs up

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, it's room twelve. My heater stopped working.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪts rum twɛlv maɪ ˈhitər ˈstɑpt ˈwɜrkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是十二號房的住戶，我的暖氣壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's bad with this cold snap outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts bæd wɪð ðɪs koʊld snæp ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哦不，外面這麼冷，那就麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's pretty freezing in here already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ ɪts ˈprɪti ˈfrizɪŋ ɪn hɪr ɔˈlɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，屋子裡已經快凍僵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, when did you first notice the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /oˈkeɪ wɛn dɪd ju fɜrst ˈnoʊtɪs ðə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 了解，你什麼時候發現問題的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night. It just blows cold air now.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt ɪt dʒʌst bloʊz koʊld ɛr naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚開始的，現在吹出來的只有冷風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Does it make any weird noises?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt dʌz ɪt meɪk ˈɛni wɪrd ˈnɔɪzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。它會發出奇怪的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, there's a clicking sound when I turn it on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ðɛrz ə ˈklɪkɪŋ saʊnd wɛn aɪ tɜrn ɪt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我開機的時候會喀噠喀噠響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, that helps. Can we enter if you're out?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ðæt hɛps kæn wi ˈɛntər ɪf jur aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這對我有幫助。如果你不在家，我們可以進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, you can come in anytime. It's fine with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ju kæn kʌm ɪn ˈɛniˌtaɪm ɪts faɪn wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以，你們隨時進去都沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. I'll send Marco this afternoon, around two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪl sɛnd ˈmɑrkoʊ ðɪs ˌæftərˈnun əˈraʊnd tu/
dialogue.zh: 好的。我今天下午兩點左右請 Marco 過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works. Will it take long to fix?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks wɪl ɪt teɪk lɔŋ tə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 時間沒問題。修起來要很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually under an hour. Sometimes it's just a part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli ˈʌndər əˈaʊər ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ɪts dʒʌst ə pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 通常不到一小時，有時只是換個零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Anything I should do before then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ ʃʊd du bɪˈfɔr ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。事前有什麼要我配合的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just clear the space around the heater, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst klɪr ðə speɪs əˈraʊnd ði ˈhitər pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請先把暖氣旁邊的空間清出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. Thanks so much for coming so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ fɔr ˈkʌmɪŋ soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。非常感謝你們處理得這麼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem at all. We'll keep you warm, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ət ˈɔl wil kip ju wɔrm ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，保證讓你暖暖過冬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds good. Have a nice afternoon!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Marco will text when he arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ˈmɑrkoʊ wɪl tɛkst wɛn hi əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 你也是！Marco 到的時候會傳訊息給你。
